adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the `onError` handler builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` and then calls `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")`. Because `message` is always a (non-empty) string due to template-string interpolation (even when `err.data?.code` is `undefined`, it becomes e.g. `"undefined: ..."`), the `unable_to_add_guests` fallback is effectively unreachable and users may see an incorrect `undefined:` prefix instead of the intended fallback.
